name: SAP Concur Expense Entry Structure
description: Structural documentation for the SAP Concur Expense Entry object, representing a single expense line item within a report.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: System-generated unique identifier for the entry

fields.name: ReportID
fields.description: ID of the parent expense report

fields.name: TransactionAmount
fields.description: Expense amount in original transaction currency

fields.name: TransactionCurrencyCode
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the expense was incurred in

fields.name: PostedAmount
fields.description: Amount converted to the report's home currency

fields.name: BusinessPurpose
fields.example: Team dinner with client during sales summit

fields.name: VendorDescription
fields.description: Name of the vendor where the expense was incurred

fields.name: IsItemized
fields.description: Whether the entry has detailed itemization sub-records

fields.name: ReceiptImageID
fields.description: ID of the attached receipt image

relationships.description: Entry belongs to a parent expense report
Entry may have an associated receipt image for compliance
